# *** THE PATTERN. *** Of the Lerena fathers in this drawer whose origin can be traced at all,
# EVERY ONE is Uruguayan or married in Uruguay. Four branches, four different Argentine provinces
# of settlement - Entre Rios, Mendoza, Misiones, Buenos Aires - and one common origin across the
# river. None of them is Juan Carlos Lerena, and none of them is shown to be related to him.
# What it supports: not a link, but a BASE RATE. In this generation, an Argentine Lerena is a
# Uruguayan family's son far more often than not. Juan Carlos Lerena, who left no trace in the
# Rosario parish at all, fits that shape.
